issues.issue: Was the interpreter issue at the interview a live procedural fairness ground?
issues.applicant_position: Spouse was denied procedural fairness because no interpreter was provided at the interview.
issues.result_text: Counsel conceded the spouse should have raised the interpreter issue at the interview, so it is no longer live.

issues.issue: Was the finding that Mr. Khan directly participated in torture reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Admission relied on was insufficient and doubtful; officer erred by not ensuring the admission was unambiguous.
issues.result_text: Reasonable grounds to believe he directly participated in torture were within acceptable outcomes; reasonable.

issues.issue: Was the finding that Mr. Khan was complicit in torture by military units reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Complicity conclusion was unjustified and unintelligible; decision did not specify divisions or link him to torture.
issues.result_text: Complicity conclusion was not unreasonable and meets justification, transparency and intelligibility standards.
